# gitmoap_group_member (Resource)

Gives a person a built-in role directly on the group, which reaches the subgroups and repositories beneath it. Callers who can manage access here may add members (Maintainers and above with the built-in roles), and nobody can give a role above their own. Refused when the person already has a role here, and when the group's member limit is reached.

The token needs `group_member:add`, `group_member:read`, `group_member:update` and `group_member:remove`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_level` (String)
- `group_id` (String) Group ID
- `user_id` (String) User ID

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `parent_group_id` (String)
- `visibility` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its group_id and user_id, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_group_member.example "<group_id>/<user_id>"
```
